problems.problem: The batch has a hole at day 7 (holes: [7]), yet status.js reports quran-01-d007-p alive. Its verdict and refutation stand (packet on 3:92: Abu Jaʿfar glosses al-birr as God’s kindness, His favour in bringing the believers into His Garden, and paraphrases giving from the choicest wealth one wishes to keep). The revision was refuted only because ‘bringing them into His Garden’ could take ‘those dying in disbelief’ as its antecedent, and the refuter supplied a gated fix. The batch should not ship a day short when a sound sentence is in hand.
problems.fix: Fill day 7 with quran-01-d007-p, key ‘Ye will not attain unto piety until ye spend of that which ye love.’ (Al 'Imran 3:92, at [384]), by tabari, src as in the verdict, and s = ‘After a ransom of gold is refused to those dying in disbelief, the surah turns to giving; al-Tabari, on 3:92, reads the piety as God’s kindness in bringing the believers into His Garden, reached by giving from the wealth they most wish to keep.’ (44 words; the revrefute’s better, gated ok in scratch/revrefute-better-d007.json); re-run entry-check.js and remove 7 from holes.

problems.problem: The batch carries the original entry, not a corrected one: its src opens ‘Al-Tabari’ where the roster display name and every other al-Tabari entry have ‘al-Tabari’ (rule 9, flagged by both earlier critics), and both s and src cite ‘on 17:77 to 17:78’. In the packet (packet.js quran 32 --verse 17.78) al-Tabari has his own heading for 17:78 inside that seg, and his comment on 17:77 is about God’s way with nations that expel their messengers, with nothing on prayer, so the place sends a reader to an ayah where he says none of this. The revision fixed only the capital and was refuted on this locator.
problems.fix: s = ‘Turning from those who would drive the Prophet out, the surah gives him the hours of prayer; al-Tabari, on 17:78, takes ‘going down’ as the sun’s leaning past midday, for the noon prayer, and nightfall as the sunset prayer.’ and src = ‘al-Tabari, Jāmiʿ al-bayān, on 17:78, Tarteel QUL Arabic text via spa5k/tafsir_api, commit 9ae590a (2026)’ (the revrefute’s better); re-run entry-check.js.
